verdict.rationale: The SOS publishes one gate in advance on its public bizfile page: from August 1, 2026, web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings, and the online option is only visible once access is established. That page also explains User Access as the entity's control over who may submit filings. This is a pre-flow disclosure of an account requirement, but it covers only one filing type and never sets out the full sequence of steps. Missing for 10: an explicit published list of account, credential and identity-proofing steps for formation and other filings; any description of identity-verification requirements; confirmation that all walls are disclosed before the flow starts.
